title: Mountain formation diagram sheet
subject: Geography

intro: Lesson 9: How mountains form. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

model.title: Why are the Himalayas still growing?

parts.text: It pushes into the Eurasian plate

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: The plates are still pushing, so the mountains are still being pushed up

keywords.def: a giant piece of the Earth's crust
made when plates push together and rock crumples
made by layers of lava and ash

questions.q: Which type of mountain is Mount Fuji?

questions.a: A giant piece of the Earth's crust

questions.q: Core: Draw and label two diagrams: how a fold mountain forms and how a volcanic mountain forms.
questions.a: Labelled diagrams with plates, arrows and folds; magma, vent and layers

questions.q: Extend: Write an explanation of fold mountains using 'first', 'then', 'so'.
questions.a: First the plates push together, then the rock layers fold, so mountains rise

questions.q: Stretch: Why are fold mountains found in long lines?
questions.a: They form along the edges where plates meet
A) Plates push together. Pushing plates crumple rock layers into folds.

questions.q: Big question: how can rock be pushed so high?
questions.a: Tectonic plates push together with huge force and fold the rock upwards over millions of years
